ex_openai.text:
theorem length_eq_card_vertices (P : Polygon) : P.length = P.vertices.card := by
  have h := graphDegree_sum P.val
  change (∑ v ∈ P.vertices, graphDegree P.val v) = _ at h
  have hsum : (∑ v ∈ P.vertices, graphDegree P.val v) = 2 * (P.vertices.card : ℤ) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun v hv => P.degree_two v hv)]
    simp [mul_comm]
  rw [hsum] at h
  unfold length
  omega

theorem four_smul_cancel {m : ℕ} {S T : Elem ℤ m}
    (h : (4 : ℤ) • S = (4 : ℤ) • T) : S = T := by
  apply AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro j
  have hj := congrArg (fun f : Elem ℤ m => f.coeff j) h
  change 4 * S.coeff j = 4 * T.coeff j at hj
  omega

ex_mathlib.name: exists_pow_eq_pow_two_mul
ex_mathlib.text:
theorem exists_pow_eq_pow_two_mul {p : ℕ} (hx : x ^ p = 1) (hp : Odd p) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ m, x ^ n = x ^ (2 * m) := by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hp
  have key : x ^ (2 * (r + 1)) = x := by
    have h2 : 2 * (r + 1) = 2 * r + 1 + 1 := by omega
    rw [h2, pow_succ, hx, one_mul]
  exact ⟨(r + 1) * n, by rw [← mul_assoc, pow_mul, key]⟩

ex_openai.name: OAI.Problem348.AnchorRigidity.host_nonanchor_col_one_group
ex_openai.text:
theorem host_nonanchor_col_one_group {h : ℕ}
    (c : VariablePosition h ⊕ Fin (2 ^ h)) (t : Mode h)
    (u v : Fin 64) (x y : Fin (2 ^ h))
    (hu : host (Sum.inl (t, u, x)) (Sum.inr c) = true)
    (hv : host (Sum.inl (t, v, y)) (Sum.inr c) = true) : u = v := by
  change decide ((u.val = 0 ∧ colRole t 0 (Sum.inr c)) ∨
    (u.val = 1 ∧ colRole t 1 (Sum.inr c))) = true at hu
  change decide ((v.val = 0 ∧ colRole t 0 (Sum.inr c)) ∨
    (v.val = 1 ∧ colRole t 1 (Sum.inr c))) = true at hv
  have hu' := of_decide_eq_true hu
  have hv' := of_decide_eq_true hv
  rcases hu' with ⟨hu0, hc0⟩ | ⟨hu1, hc1⟩
  · rcases hv' with ⟨hv0, _⟩ | ⟨_, hc1⟩
    · exact Fin.ext (hu0.trans hv0.symm)
    · exact False.elim (colRole_disjoint t (Sum.inr c) ⟨hc0, hc1⟩)
  · rcases hv' with ⟨_, hc0⟩ | ⟨hv1, _⟩
    · exact False.elim (colRole_disjoint t (Sum.inr c) ⟨hc0, hc1⟩)
    · exact Fin.ext (hu1.trans hv1.symm)

theorem prime_def_lt' {p : ℕ} : Prime p ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → m < p → ¬m ∣ p :=
  prime_def_lt.trans <|
    and_congr_right fun p2 =>
      forall_congr' fun m =>
        ⟨fun h m2 l d => not_lt_of_ge m2 ((h l d).symm ▸ by decide), fun h l d => by
          rcases m with (_ | _ | m)
          · omega
          · rfl
          · exact (h (le_add_left 2 m) l).elim d⟩

ex_openai.name: OAI.Barnette.TriangleSystem.Pair.bits_invariant
ex_openai.text:
theorem bits_invariant (P : @Pair A V T X) (Q : P.Group) (t : A) :
    P.bits Q (P.next t) = P.bits Q t := by
  have h0 := P.group_values Q t
  have h1 := P.group_values Q (P.next t)
  cases ht : P.bits Q t <;> cases hn : P.bits Q (P.next t)
  · rfl
  · simp only [ht, hn, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h0 h1
    exact False.elim (P.next_ne t (Q.val.right.value_injective
      (h1.2.trans ((P.value_next t).trans h0.2.symm))))
  · simp only [ht, hn, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h0 h1
    exact False.elim (P.next_ne t (Q.val.left.value_injective
      (h1.1.trans ((P.value_next t).trans h0.1.symm))))
  · rfl

  have ha := first_bounds a
  have hb := first_bounds b

    (Radix.prefix_le_prefix_iff a).mpr hb.2.1,

theorem Formula.coeff_support_finite {F : Type*} {n : ℕ} [Semiring F]

  classical
  let bound := (Finset.range (f.size + 1)).biUnion (wordsOfLength n)
  apply Set.Finite.subset bound.finite_toSet
  intro w hw
  have hlen : w.length ≤ f.size := by
    by_contra h
    exact hw (f.coeff_eq_zero_of_length_gt w (by omega))

    (mem_wordsOfLength w).mpr rfl⟩

ex_openai.text:
lemma longest_binomial_lower_bound (μ : YoungDiagram) (b : ℕ)
    (hb : b ≤ min (maxLine μ) (deficit μ)) :
    (maxLine μ).choose b ≤ standardCount μ := by
  by_cases h : μ.colLen 0 ≤ μ.rowLen 0
  · have he : maxLine μ=μ.rowLen 0 := max_eq_left h
    rw [he]
    exact binomial_lower_bound μ b (by simpa only [deficit,he] using hb)
  · have hb' : b ≤ min (μ.transpose.rowLen 0)
        (μ.transpose.cells.card - μ.transpose.rowLen 0) := by
      simpa only [deficit,maxLine,max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h),
        card_transpose,YoungDiagram.rowLen_transpose] using hb
    simpa only [YoungDiagram.rowLen_transpose,standardCount_transpose,
      maxLine,max_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)] using binomial_lower_bound μ.transpose b hb'

  have : Finite F := (Nat.card_pos_iff.1 (by omega)).2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : IsCyclic Fˣ := by infer_instance
  refine ⟨x, Units.ne_zero x, fun h ↦ ?_⟩

ex_openai.text:
theorem graphMean_le_one {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1)
    (f : GraphConfig n → Bool) : graphMean p f ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  calc
    graphMean p f ≤ ∑ x : GraphConfig n, graphWeight p x := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro x hx
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (graphWeight_nonneg hp hp1 x) (boolReal_le_one (f x))
    _ = 1 := graphWeight_sum p

ex_openai.name: OAI.Problem326.Affine.abs_sum_mul_le
ex_openai.text:
theorem abs_sum_mul_le (ι : Type uIota) [Fintype ι]
    (u v : ι → ℝ) :
    |∑ i, u i * v i| ≤ ‖u‖ * ∑ i, |v i| := by
  classical
  calc
    |∑ i, u i * v i| ≤ ∑ i, |u i * v i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i, |u i| * |v i| := by simp only [abs_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ‖u‖ * |v i| := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_le_pi_norm u i) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = ‖u‖ * ∑ i, |v i| := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

ex_openai.name: OAI.PartialPermutation.YoungTabloid.cross_rowMoment_le
ex_openai.text:
lemma cross_rowMoment_le (μ ν : YoungDiagram) (e : μ.cells ≃ ν.cells) (r : Tabloid ν)
    (hr : CrossTransversal μ (fun x => r.1 (e x))) : rowMoment μ ≤ rowMoment ν := by
  calc
    rowMoment μ = ∑ x, row μ (crossSorting μ _ hr x) :=
      (Equiv.sum_comp (crossSorting μ _ hr) (row μ)).symm
    _ ≤ ∑ x, r.1 (e x) := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => crossSorting_row μ _ hr x)
    _ = ∑ x, r.1 x := Equiv.sum_comp e r.1
    _ = rowMoment ν := rowSum ν r

ex_mathlib.name: MeasureTheory.withDensity_apply_le
ex_mathlib.text:
theorem withDensity_apply_le (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (s : Set α) :
    ∫⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ ≤ μ.withDensity f s := by
  let t := toMeasurable (μ.withDensity f) s
  calc
  ∫⁻ a in s, f a ∂μ ≤ ∫⁻ a in t, f a ∂μ :=
    lintegral_mono_set (subset_toMeasurable (withDensity μ f) s)
  _ = μ.withDensity f t :=
    (withDensity_apply f (measurableSet_toMeasurable (withDensity μ f) s)).symm
  _ = μ.withDensity f s := measure_toMeasurable s

  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · calc
      _ ≤ hausdorffEDist (closure s) s + hausdorffEDist s t := hausdorffEDist_triangle
      _ = hausdorffEDist s t := by simp [hausdorffEDist_comm]
  · calc
      _ ≤ hausdorffEDist s (closure s) + hausdorffEDist (closure s) t := hausdorffEDist_triangle
      _ = hausdorffEDist (closure s) t := by simp

ex_human.name: TileStructure.Forest.dist_χtilde_le
ex_human.text:
lemma dist_χtilde_le (mx : x ∈ 𝓘 u₁) (mx' : x' ∈ 𝓘 u₁) :
    dist (χtilde J u₁ x) (χtilde J u₁ x') ≤ dist x x' / D ^ s J :=
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(8 - D ^ (-s J) * dist x (c J)) - (8 - D ^ (-s J) * dist x' (c J))‖ := by
      rw [χtilde, indicator_of_mem mx, indicator_of_mem mx']
      change ‖(_ - _ : ℝ)‖ ≤ _
      simp_rw [NNReal.val_eq_coe, Real.coe_toNNReal']
      exact norm_sup_sub_sup_le_norm ..
    _ = ‖dist x' (c J) - dist x (c J)‖ / D ^ (s J) := by
      rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_left, ← mul_sub, zpow_neg, ← div_eq_inv_mul, norm_div]; simp
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, dist_comm x x']; exact abs_dist_sub_le ..
